description: This source file contains code for a scalable, multi-phase scenario simulation framework, including scenario analysis, factor graph generation, entity batch creation, decision simulation, and result aggregation using AI models. It handles large-scale simulations by batching operations, controlling concurrency, and analyzing outputs to generate insights about user behaviors and decision patterns.

classes.name: ScenarioAnalysis
classes.description: Schema for detailed scenario decomposition including entity type, decision type, options, and analysis.

classes.name: FactorGraph
classes.description: Schema for representing the causal attribute relationship graph, including attributes, their descriptions, the graph structure, and sampling strategies.

classes.name: EntityProfile
classes.description: Schema for individual entity attribute data and a human-readable profile summary.

classes.name: EntityBatch
classes.description: Schema for a batch of entities represented as a list of attribute dictionaries.

classes.name: EntityDecision
classes.description: Schema for an entity's decision, confidence level, key influencer attribute, trade-off, and reasoning.

classes.name: SimulationInsights
classes.description: Schema for storing the aggregation results, including decision distributions, key insights, causal drivers, and segment patterns.

methods.name: decompose_scenario
methods.description: Analyzes the scenario to identify entity type, decision types, options, and comprehensive decision analysis.

methods.name: generate_factor_graph
methods.description: Creates a detailed factor graph describing key attributes, their relationships, and sampling strategies.

methods.name: generate_entity_batch
methods.description: Generates a batch of synthetic entities with attributes, diversity, and realistic correlations, using AI batching.

methods.name: generate_entity_batch_optimized
methods.description: Internal function to generate multiple entities efficiently in batches for scalability.

methods.name: simulate_entity_decision_safe
methods.description: Simulates an individual entity's decision with error handling, using a simplified prompt to avoid JSON parsing issues.

methods.name: simulate_entity_decision
methods.description: Wrapper around the safe decision simulation, raises error if decision generation fails.

methods.name: simulate_batch_decisions
methods.description: Performs decision simulation for a list of entities in parallel, with error handling, rate limiting, and progress reporting.

methods.name: aggregate_and_analyze
methods.description: Produces aggregated insights from entities and decisions, including outcome distributions, segment analysis, and key drivers.

methods.name: run_simulation
methods.description: Main orchestrator that manages scenario analysis, factor graph creation, entity generation, decision simulation, and final insights, optimized for large N.
